hooks.name: link_register_shim
hooks.verification: stock 10 bytes asserted; pointer constants asserted: [0x106d9d9c]=0x19750d2c (launcher business-15 table), [0x106d9da0]=0x106d97f1 (its stock slot-0 callback); RNLink registry literal asserted: [0x10776460]=[0x107763d8]=0x1987c780
hooks.purpose: Inside LinkMonitor::registerLinkCallback: call cfw_register_shim, which registers the module's RNLink callback table for business 0xF0 (rnlink_if_register_callback, the interface vtable's +8 slot) once, then replays the displaced stock instructions unchanged (slot [0x19750d2c+0x18] stays NULL).

hooks.name: ancs_relay_hook
hooks.verification: stock 4 bytes asserted to be `bl handleAncsNotificationReceived` (0x107029d1), the symbol table address asserted
hooks.purpose: Inside NotificationMessageHandler::handleMessage: call cfw_ancs_hook(this, msg) instead of handleAncsNotificationReceived; the hook queues the notification JSON (msg->data/bytes) as business-0xF0 ANCS records and tail-calls the stock handler, so the on-glass popup and whitelist are unchanged.
